suite: numeric versus symbolic native policy output
scope: private inet namespace, not host bridge or runtime acceptance

argv:
set -eu
/usr/sbin/nft -f - <<'NFT'
add table inet gh_snapshot_a
add set inet gh_snapshot_a live { type ifname; flags timeout; timeout 10s; }
add element inet gh_snapshot_a live { "lo" timeout 10s }
add chain inet gh_snapshot_a input { type filter hook input priority -190; policy accept; }
add rule inet gh_snapshot_a input iifname @live counter accept
add rule inet gh_snapshot_a input ip6 hoplimit 255 icmpv6 type { nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert } icmpv6 code 0 counter accept
add chain inet gh_snapshot_a pre { type nat hook prerouting priority -105; policy accept; }
add rule inet gh_snapshot_a pre meta nfproto ipv4 tcp dport 443 counter dnat ip to 198.19.1.1:18080
NFT
/usr/sbin/nft -j -n list table inet gh_snapshot_a
/usr/sbin/nft -j list ruleset
/usr/sbin/nft -j -n list ruleset
